description: 해양수산부 국립해양조사원_항만해양지수 조회 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. 이 데이터는 해양수산부 국립해양조사원에서 해수의 유동, 바람, 파랑 등을 종합적으로 고려하여 항만해양활동의 안전성 정보를 4단계화한 결과를 제공하기 위해 제작되었습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부 국립해양조사원. Its tags are 항만해양활동, 안전지표, 유속 영향, 지수정보, 지역별. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
